decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric fell from its own page to a mention, which suggests results near or below aspiration, but it sits close to the core range and costs little to carry in a growing industry.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric has held a steady mention, which points to satisfactory if modest results, and as a low-cost item in a broad collection it gives no trigger for problemistic search.
The flame-retardant jacquard serves the contract and hospitality demand the firm targets and kept its own page in both years, so its results appear to meet aspiration.
The double-face wool-blend fabric has a stable mention and supports the shift toward renewable materials, so modest results are tolerable given the slack from industry growth.
The wool bouclé leno is still mentioned and fits the sustainable, design-led direction, but its low visibility leaves some risk that it is pruned in a collection refresh.
The braided-structure fabric was launched recently and featured on its own page, so its results are still uncertain and the firm has the slack to carry it while it builds performance.
